item.subject: science
item.stem: During a class discussion at her school in Jaipur, Meera says that adolescence is only about physical changes like height and voice. Her friend Arjun disagrees. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Arjun is correct, because adolescence also brings emotional and behavioural changes, and understanding these emotions can help a person make thoughtful choices
options.B: Meera is correct, because adolescence involves only physical changes and feelings are separate personal issues
options.C: Arjun is correct, because stronger emotions during adolescence automatically lead to more thoughtful choices without any effort to understand them
options.D: Meera is correct, because emotional changes such as excitement and confusion are not part of adolescence
